ui.title: TSLA · Investor Dashboard · Claes Berg
ui.description: Unofficial personal investor dashboard for Tesla (Nasdaq: TSLA), built for Claes Berg. Not affiliated with Tesla, Inc.
ui.intradayCaption: Live U.S. last sale during pre-market, regular session, and after-hours; Hyperliquid xyz:TSLA when the U.S. market is closed. Time in CET/CEST.
ui.newsLede: Tesla IR updates and shareholder letters, SEC filings, media, and posts from @Tesla, @elonmusk (Tesla-related only), @robotaxi and @teslaenergy. Filters apply to the list. Topics such as Robotaxi, FSD, Optimus, Energy and Cybertruck are tagged.
ui.kpiLede: Taken from Tesla’s quarterly Update decks (Exhibit 99.1 to the earnings 8-Ks) and the Q3 2026 10-Q, Q4 2024 through Q3 2026. Nothing is estimated or interpolated — every bar is a reported figure.
ui.footerData: Data: Yahoo Finance (server-side), CNBC real-time U.S. last sale and 1-minute bars (browser), Hyperliquid xyz:TSLA (live mid and 5-minute candles in the browser, 24/7), Tesla Update decks and SEC filings (10-Q, 8-K, DEF 14A, 13G), Google News RSS, StockAnalysis / S&P Global for Street estimates. X posts were last pulled on 13 Nov 2026 into this repo. Publish times in the news feed are shown in Europe/Stockholm as CET or CEST.
